name: Freshuelva
aliases: Asociación Onubense de Productores y Exportadores de Fresas
description: Association of red-fruit (strawberry, blueberry, raspberry, blackberry) growers and exporters in Huelva, Spain -- the dominant Spanish and one of the dominant European berry production regions. Operating since 1983 (per its own site, freshuelva.es). Its own site publishes member-company profiles (already used elsewhere in this dataset as the source for the Atlantic Blue S.L. blueberry breeding-programme profile) and a news section, and it is a recurring voice in real trade coverage of Huelva berry exports, storm/weather damage, and seasonal migrant-labor conditions.
